title: Amazon Hikes Prices by as Much as 60% Across Echo, Fire TV, Kindle Lines
summary: One of the only product lines spared was Amazon's Ring series, which saw no price rises. Fire Stick competitor Roku bumped the prices of its Roku Ultra streaming device $50, from $100 to $150.
